h2.default: How a study runs with Alpha

p.default: One scientific point of contact from first call to final report. Each stage goes one layer deeper.

p_2.default: We talk through your compound, target and decision point, and recommend the model and endpoints that answer it.

p_3.default: You receive a study design, timeline and quote. We prepare formulations, vehicles and induction reagents.

p_4.default: Dosing, imaging, sampling and in-life observations, with progress updates on the schedule you choose.

p_5.default: Analyzed results, raw data and a review call with the scientist who ran your study.

p_6.default: Tell us your compound, target and decision point. A senior scientist will recommend the model and endpoints that answer it.
